title: SYCOPHANTIC ANCHORS: LOCALIZING AND QUANTIFYING USER AGREEMENT IN REASONING MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Using counterfactual rollouts on a multi-turn adversarial dataset to identify 'sycophantic anchors' (specific sentences in the reasoning trace that cause the model to commit to incorrect user suggestions), and training linear probes and MLP regressors on hidden state activations to detect and quantify this bias mid-inference.
